cohort: Named history within uninterrupted PlayOn; no current identified sighting; last identified position 1-30 cycles old; valid known-number WM position and same-cycle truth. Unknown proximity-matched tracks excluded. Equal weight per paired target-cycle.
caveat: Offline position-error benefit/harm, not measured action quality or game outcomes. One training seed. Covariance ellipses are calibrated total-mixture moment ellipses, not separate confidence guarantees for individual components.

error_change_bucket_definition.change: model error minus librcsc error; positive means worse
error_change_bucket_definition.intervals: better < -tolerance; no change within tolerance; worse up to .01, .05, .25, .50 meters and above; tolerance also applies at boundaries

omission_study.classification: Post-hoc diagnostic; no retraining or test-driven weight/gate tuning.
omission_study.filter_definition: Union of anonymous_current and unnamed_wm_refresh. In this paired no-current-named-sighting cohort, unnamed_wm_refresh equals WM position count 0.
omission_study.limitation: Anonymous entries are attached to true target IDs by the evaluation logger. Exact target-level union fallback is a diagnostic, not a directly deployable identity rule. WM position count is observable.
